static_traits.name: Wang Lin
static_traits.family_status: Living alone,Living with a pet dog
static_traits.social_status: At the workplace, difficulty connecting with colleagues because of worry about being judged; has one close friend who can be confided in
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness; no prior similar psychological problems or psychotherapy history
static_traits.language_features: Expresses clearly, fairly logical, capable of self-Reflection and Identifying automatic thoughts; emotionally Anxiety-leaning, highly self-focused; Good cooperation, steady speech rate

basic_info.main_problem: Feels that colleagues judge me because I often talk about my dog; I believe they think I am overly obsessed with my pet and hold negative views of me.
basic_info.core_demands: I just do not want to be this Anxiety all the time.

core_beliefs: I am an off-putting / weird person
My worth depends on what others think of me

special_situations.event: Overhearing colleagues' negative comments about 'people who talk too much about pets' a few months ago
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I talk about my dog at work, I will be considered overly obsessed and strange
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries to avoid talking about the pet and steers the conversation back to work topics
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will think I am annoying, that I am a weirdo

special_situations.event: Pet or other personal topics come up in office conversation
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I talk about personal interests, I will be negatively evaluated and seem unprofessional
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Quickly shifting the topic or staying Silence, reducing participation
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They definitely think I am annoying and weird in their hearts

special_situations.event: When noticing colleagues' expressions or tone not warm enough
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If the other person does not look enthusiastic, it means they are judging me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Stops sharing personal content, talks only about facts and work details
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They secretly dislike me / find me annoying

special_situations.event: Before preparing to share any personal content at work
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I expose real interests, I will be labeled 'weird' and excluded
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Completely avoids self-disclosure, communicates only about work
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Once I mention the dog, they will look down on me

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be accepted by colleagues, able to freely share real interests and be seen and respected
defense_goal: Lowers the risk of being judged by keeping distance and avoiding personal topics
Narrows the topic to work matters to gain a sense of safety

object_relations.self_representation: A person easily disliked, who needs to hide oneself carefully
object_relations.object_representation: A picky, negating group of colleagues

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When office conversation turns to pets or other personal topics
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Experiences colleagues as belittling oneself like past negative commenters (viewing others as critics)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Quickly turn back to Work topics, using brief, objective statements; avoid self-disclosure, reduce eye contact.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When noticing the other person's expression not warm enough or Silence
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Interprets neutral silence/fatigue as belittling and disgust toward oneself
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Reporting work details rationally, avoiding expressing feelings, ending conversations in a flat tone.

manifestations: Avoids personal topics for fear of being judged, reducing self-disclosure and sense of connection
Feels isolated at work, difficult to build close relationships with colleagues
Still troubled by others' opinions after work, Sleep affected
outcomes: Interpersonal alienation and Increased sense of loneliness

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Highly self-censors before discussing personal topics; shrinks expression out of worry about being judged
Frequently speculates about others' thoughts, cautiously controls words and actions

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact, corresponding to 'acceptance'.
manifestations: Immediately shifting to Work topics when conversation involves pets/personal content
Avoids deep contact by minimizing participation and quickly ending conversations

exception_events.target_problem: When office conversations involve personal/pet topics, Wang Lin usually experiences intense Anxiety, mind-reads being judged, and retreats through Silence or topic-shifting, making interactions distant.
exception_events.unique_outcome: In a few exchanges discussing only Work-related content, Wang Lin did not avoid as usual, could participate naturally, interactions went smoothly, and subjective Anxiety was markedly lower.
exception_events.reason: Clues: topics focused on Work, lower evaluation threat; different approach: focusing on tasks and facts, easier to gain a sense of control and safety.

positive_force: Has the willingness to seek help and is willing to try cognitive restructuring and reality testing
Able to identify one's own automatic thoughts and do preliminary reappraisal
Has one close friend to confide in who provides basic support
Able to interact Good in Work exchanges on non-personal topics, with effective communication skills
negative_force: Excessive reliance on external evaluation to determine self-worth (External Validation)
Often interpreting others through mind-reading and predicting the future (Mind Reading, Fortune Telling)
Avoiding personal topics damages interpersonal connections and worsens the sense of Loneliness
Sleep disturbed and ruminative worries maintain Anxiety

target_behavior.behavior: In work settings, avoids personal topics and minimizes participation
antecedent: Office conversations involving pets or other personal topics
Recalls a colleague's comment about 'talking too much about pets'
target_behavior.core_reason: Fears being judged and humiliated, with mind reading and catastrophic predictions of negative outcomes
target_behavior.function: Avoiding the possibility of negative evaluation and shame, gaining a temporary sense of safety
target_behavior.consequence: Damaged interpersonal connections, increased sense of Loneliness, Decline in work performance

target_behavior.behavior: Sleep disturbed from repeatedly worrying about colleagues' opinions before bed
antecedent: Before sleep, thinks about whether colleagues see one as 'weird'
target_behavior.core_reason: High dependence on external evaluation and ruminative thinking maintain Anxiety
target_behavior.function: Tries to prevent potential social 'mistakes' through excessive worry, gaining a superficial sense of control
target_behavior.consequence: Difficulty falling asleep, Declining sleep quality, next-day Anxiety and Decreased work efficiency
